reasoning_content:
Before submitting Step 3, verify the default claim mapping. According to the code, the defaults are:
- oidc_user_id_claim => "name"
- oidc_displayname_claim => "name"
- oidc_email_claim => "email"

These are pre-populated in the form. If the value is empty, the controller will use the defaults. The guide doesn't specify the claim mapping fields (the guide is outdated on this point — it just says "Step 3 - First Login"). To confirm the pre-populated values, let's check the form's input fields in the HTML.

action.command: cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap && grep -o '<input[^>]*name="oidc_[a-z_]*_claim"[^>]*>' step3.html | head -5; grep -o '<select[^>]*name="[a-z_]*refresh_mode"[^>]*value=[^>]*>' step3.html | head -4

tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap && grep -o '<input[^>]*name=\"oidc_[a-z_]*_claim\"[^>]*>' step3.html | head -5; grep -o '<select[^>]*name=\"[a-z_]*refresh_mode\"[^>]*value=[^>]*>' step3.html | head -4", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Check pre-filled claim mapping values"}
